repair an inconvenient requirement by silently changing the common `WHAT`.

Each affected requirement identifies its realizing operation or invariant, interface-preservation obligation and evidence capable of defeating realization. Bindings preserve applicable authority, required human decisions, independence, failure and recovery conditions; convenient environments cannot weaken them. Material context, time, memory, communication, human effort and spend state units and are measured at declared boundaries. Context fit and attention adequacy have distinct cited evidence conditions; categorical preservation additionally invokes Orthogonal descriptions. grounding.quote:

bounded work wave, ticket state remains ticket authority, and comments remain
non-authoritative commentary.

Bindings may resolve to directories, repository resources, tracker collections, API endpoints or Product-scoped queries. Goals own the wave, tickets own ticket state, and comments are non-authoritative.

grounding.quote: Resolution verifies both locator and expected identity.

constraints.statement: Directory nesting creates no inheritance, ownership, composition or override. Every composition entry supplies product_definition, target_definition_id matching target product.definition_id, a relation authority defining direction/roles/owner/scope/lifecycle/invalidation and at least one exact interface/capability/identity/lifecycle/data/evidence/other governing contract. Moving a definition requires a locator update, not identity change; another identity at the same locator fails closed. Exact immutable Product/release identities, when bound, must also be carried and verified by relation/contracts; mutable definition identity cannot substitute. A conforming set requires every definition to validate against its selected released schema; every required URI/fragment to resolve within declared boundaries; globally unique definition IDs and tenant IDs unique within each overlay; applicable resolvable frame bases for every scope and authoritative reconciliation of overlaps; each disambiguation to bind exact term, context, complete material candidate set, selected concept, authority, basis and scope, with resolves_to in disambiguates and a congruent resolution carrier; every material cross-context seam to use explicit import/disambiguation/translation/equivalence, never name matching; every target, relation and non-empty contract set to resolve; and no competing carriers for Product, tenant, ticket-state or constitutional authority. Draft 2020-12 validation establishes structure only; URI formats are annotations unless asserted. Conformance explicitly checks RFC 3986 syntax using an assertion-capable validator, then separately checks resolution, fragments, selected-release identity, cross-file uniqueness, constitutional sufficiency, semantic and cross-context completeness, and authority congruence.

conditions: Under an exact selected basis.
The collision-case outcomes apply without an explicit cross-context relation.

grounding.quote:
Correct downstream behavior produced through a
guessed meaning does not pass semantic conformance.

constraints.statement: Minimum cases preserve: evaluation Frame versus consumer runtime Frame, with no nominal enrollment; specialist evaluation Owner versus semantic/decision owner, with no acquired owner authority; immutable released Product versus mutable Product Definition, selected only by occurrence context; build Tenant versus hosted/customer/account/runtime/data tenancy, with no build-tenancy default; and User roles/person/principal/account/actor/operator/data subject as unresolved until downstream authority defines or explicitly relates meanings. A positive local case declares one context and resolves exactly one concept; a positive cross-context case supplies the complete authorized relation. Negative cases include zero candidates, multiple candidates after disambiguation, selected concept outside candidates, context-free glossary fallback, incomplete coordinates, authority/basis mismatch, undeclared loss and invalidated relations. Guessed meaning cannot pass through correct downstream behavior.

conditions: Derived instructions operate within their declared scope.
exceptions: A concrete form is method law when explicitly accepted by the method as an interoperability boundary.
STDO Product-scope expansion requires separate explicit human authorization.

grounding.quote: Only a released method version is publication authority.

constraints.statement: A view cannot change a claim's meaning or authority under the selected constitution. Standards operate only as one complete released version admitted by release authority. Compressions, templates, comments, candidates, installed copies and mutable source cannot become partial constitutions or reinterpret owners. Derived instructions preserve applicability, obligations, permissions, exclusions, decision owners and invalidators; correct digests do not excuse losing a prohibition's condition or lawful alternative. Compression cannot strengthen or weaken relations; references must resolve within the actor's access or required meaning must be supplied directly. STDO owns normative construction algebra, authority, abstract state/transition laws, admissibility, necessary causal order and evidence invariants; consumers own concrete types, schemas, files, tools, runtimes, orchestration, tests and executable conformance. A shared-method amendment cannot itself create tools, workflow engines, runtimes, assurance systems or consumer realizations as STDO Product scope. Recording a ruling cannot widen its subject, implication, authority or change class. Mutable source may author future cuts but must not silently govern consumers.
constraints.uncertainty: F2, F3, F6 and the faithful-projection contract are cited but not supplied.

exceptions: Design selects placement and mechanisms unless the path itself is constitutional.
Tenant-local realization becomes governing truth only when ratified in specification.

grounding.quote: Every link in the chain is load-bearing.

constraints.statement: Downstream success requires adequate upstream meaning and traceable authority; Goals/Product owners select outcomes and Design selects any allowed realization, not a uniquely derived implementation. Observations bind declared boundaries; events are durable carriers where selected. Projection is checked against source and current state, creates no second truth and need not require complete event replay. Repricing follows intake-selected class and owner: a constitutional gap changes that layer and affected downstream span without automatically requiring new Goals/Intent; unresolved causes can require more observation. Broken links, including no repricing path, unowned requirements, ungrounded design or realization lacking design decisions, create accidental law. Workspace state persists: each activation's current material state and valid authority define A; Z is admitted acceptance constraints. Actors acquire sufficient context for the next bounded transition; discarded context does not rewind A. Observation may invalidate beliefs/results but cannot silently change Z or grant permission; revising Z uses owning re-entry. GOALS.md carries the temporary work wave; PRODUCT.md states present-tense mutable Product definition, terms and boundaries, not immutable RC or installed Product. Requirements cover all constitutional obligations, not only features. Design chooses structural realization, topology, carriers, control/runtime wiring and lawful tenant boundaries. The what/how split is independent of layout.

grounding.quote: Deferred compliance inside a sprint is escrow, not acceptance.

constraints.statement: A sprint must not create, supersede, weaken or override Goals/Intent/Product/Requirements/Design authority. It states at least served goal/wave, upstream authority, admitted scope, excluded Product/requirement/design/runtime/data-contract/governance boundaries, expected change classes, any deferrable local proof/compliance debt, closure trigger/law and paydown/repricing path. Proof deferral is lawful only while local, visible, bounded and repayable. Escrow cannot satisfy method/release/Product closure until paid down, explicitly accepted under governing method, or repriced upstream. Close may be recommended—not automatically required—on timebox expiry, scope attainment, changed-area cost exceeding review, unsafe review uncertainty or gaps outgrowing the container. Close compares work/evidence with authority, classifies every gap, accepts compliant work, opens local-debt paydown and escalates drift lawfully. Discovery of any Product-truth change, including goal/intent/Product/requirement/design/runtime/data-contract/governance change, does not authorize landing it: split, escalate, reprice or explicitly carry paydown under governing method. Ticket Method owns mechanics; domain refinements may define appropriate escrow use.
constraints.uncertainty: Ticket and domain-specific mechanics are referenced but absent.

conditions: Material unresolved interpretation exists.
At each major boundary, remaining or newly introduced major ambiguity is subject to recording.

grounding.quote: Major ambiguity must always be surfaced and governed.

constraints.statement: Unsupported meaning cannot become established result or permission. Graph/runtime F_D, F_P and F_H remain graph-native ODD concepts absent explicit import/translation. The chain progressively narrows priority, direction/scope, Product shape/terms, obligations, executable class, structure and implementation detail. Major ambiguity cannot hide in operator judgment, precedent or silent model choice. Each major boundary detects/records ambiguity, affected invariant/asset/decision boundary, decision if work proceeds, and resolved/carried/escalated/blocked handling. Declared Product policy and risk appetite determine lawful probabilistic carrying/decision versus explicit human adjudication, never convenience; lower risk appetite escalates more, higher permits more bounded probabilistic choice, but both record ambiguity and decision. The aim is visible governed progressive reduction to sufficient constraint, not elimination of all ambiguity before any work.

grounding.quote:
Admissibility and fulfillment of the interrupted task remain separate
predicates: refusal alone does not establish that the intended outcome failed.

constraints.statement: For 'identified ambiguity is resolved under governing meaning', established resolution is satisfied, established remaining ambiguity falsified, and insufficient evidence indeterminate, retaining invalid_basis/out_of_frame diagnoses. Carried/escalated ambiguity may remain unresolved. Separately, policy/authority-bound handling is satisfied when supported lawful, falsified on demonstrated violation, indeterminate when unsupported, with the same diagnoses; neither settles delivery or grants authority beyond policy. Hard stops apply regardless of risk appetite; typical classes are violated invariants/guarantees, absent required authority, missing declared execution/operation capability, undeclared irreversible effects and explicit human-approval gates. Witnessed violation or unmet required authorization falsifies the relevant admissibility predicate; missing evidence leaves it indeterminate. Fulfillment is separate: refusal proves neither failed outcome, non-performance nor absence of effects. Unusable basis and out-of-capability evaluation retain their diagnoses; undeclared or uncertain effects require actual observation before dependent action.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced core stop rule is not supplied in full.

conditions: Lifecycle postures materially affect Product meaning.
exceptions: Detailed implementation mechanisms for every phase are not required.
A non-applicable phase is allowed with an explanation.

grounding.quote:
Silent absence is not a
valid lifecycle answer.

constraints.statement: Product and requirements must supply enough constitutional signal for design to derive the lifecycle or explicitly record unresolved ambiguity. Product definition names material boundary, use context, release/install, live-use, observability and retirement/supersession postures. Requirements state governing invariants across build, assurance, release, deployment, usage, telemetry, retirement, ownership, source truth, authority and interpretation. Deferring a phase requires naming deferment and its later owning surface. Unknown phases require named gaps such as Gap: or Unanswered:; inapplicability requires why. This is ambiguity detection, not a requirement that every clause be a release plan. Missing lifecycle meaning cannot be supplied by convention, implementation precedent, prompts or fixtures: reprice its constitutional owner or carry explicit governed debt.

conditions: Every substantive change.

grounding.quote:
Every substantive change begins with intake triage, an explicit declared change
intent, and a lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain.

constraints.statement: Intake triage, explicit declared change intent and lawful constitutional re-entry are prerequisites to substantive change.

grounding.quote:
Neither finding grants
the mutation it suggests.

constraints.statement: Bugs, features, issues, regressions, operator findings, release blockers and scenario failures use the same triage; none bypasses it for code/tests/release. Determine whether change is substantive, affected Product/scope, lawful class/re-entry, downstream surfaces/evidence to reprice/rederive/reprove, and release-scope fit or repricing. Diagnose current subject, outcome, observations and any predictive model, distinguishing defective realization, inadequate requirements/design, inaccurate prediction and insufficient observation; unresolved alternatives can select observation before repair. Severity is consequence and priority response order within mandate; neither changes diagnosis nor grants repair. A bug list is a view, not another route. Triangulation uses applicable frames over the same subject/basis, their material variables, relations and evidence, retaining alternatives/uncertainty and smallest sufficient repair scope. Exposing frame need not contain cause; relabeled repeated analysis adds no evidence. Intake binds selected outcome, interpreted meaning, current observations and actual owner; demonstrated implementation defects may support lower re-entry, while implementation-versus-requirement uncertainty stays unresolved. Bind exact report, governing sources, workspace/external observations, retained results and actual assessment grant; currentness controls reuse. Computed treatment decides candidate-versus-governing correction. Select the smallest sufficient applicable frame configuration, with localization where required, without prescribing reviewer count or another round; independence and repair authority remain.
constraints.uncertainty: Shared feedback, contract-application and frame-conjunction laws are not fully supplied.

grounding.quote:
Smaller changes may re-enter below Goals only if they explicitly assert that no
upstream constitutional surface is changing.

constraints.statement: goal_reprice changes bounded work-wave focus, re-enters Goals and may propagate through Intent/Product/Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence where deeper truth changes. intent_reprice changes direction/scope and flows from Intent through Product/Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence. product_reprice changes Product realization with stable intent and flows from Product through Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence. requirement_reprice changes constitutional truth with stable direction and flows from Requirements through Design/Realisation/Evidence. design_reframe changes realization structure with stable intent and requirement truth and flows from Design through Realisation/Evidence. realization_refactor changes local implementation/procedure/configuration/attributes with no intended constitutional or structural change, enters only realization and must prove no upstream drift. conditions: Causal localization is required by assurance or intake on a declared path.
exceptions: It adds no separate pass to every change.

grounding.quote:
Satisfaction of localization never
overwrites the original counterexample's result or establishes repair success.

Record subject, basis, exactly one frontier form and its members, causal evidence, expected relations, observed counterexample and invalidated downstream claims. Do not collapse jointly necessary incomparable loci to one arbitrary owner or equate alternatives with joint cause. For 'evidence establishes this stated earliest frontier', supported unique/jointly necessary loci are satisfied; alternatives, unsupported bounded frontier or missing required reason are indeterminate; independently admissible defeating evidence is falsified; uninterpretable subject/causal basis is invalid_basis; outside scope/capability is out_of_frame. Actual performance/effects remain relevant. Localization changes neither original counterexample result nor proves repair success and grants no repair, broader test expansion, compatibility repair, additional controller or reinterpretation of unchanged meaning. Scope/design changes use existing re-entry.

conditions: Production of or reliance on C under the selected source, worksite or qualification capability.

Conflicts/missing premises stay unresolved; labels/filenames cannot route and settled rules need no invented residual judgment.

grounding.quote:
C/J/O and change classes remain annotations and treatment
choices.

constraints.statement: Comparison/coverage scopes may include any supported state, including no change/no candidate. For 'exact relation/member differs', authenticated changed is satisfied, complete equality unchanged is falsified, and missing candidate/incomplete enumeration/unavailable comparison unknown is indeterminate. For 'accepted design covers this exact changed relation', current accepted scope+trace+acceptance gives satisfied; complete absence/exclusion labeled missing/outside-scope gives falsified; undeciding missing/stale/ambiguous support gives indeterminate. For either, unusable subject/basis is invalid_basis and outside evaluation scope/capability is out_of_frame, distinct from design-scope exclusion. Missing reason is indeterminate while independently established counterevidence remains. Treatment evaluates named rule premises; applied rulings use a separate decision predicate. Neither follows from delta/coverage labels.

exceptions: An existing bounded construction/evidence grant may permit a useful discriminator, including a first candidate, despite unknown treatment.

grounding.quote: Candidate behavior cannot author its own target law.

constraints.statement: A Public delta/nonconformance alone does not require contract change. If the contract remains sufficient for the authorized outcome, reject or locally repair within grant. Re-enter the owner only when explicitly selected desired outcome requires changed meaning or applicable assessment establishes insufficiency; C derives this only from sufficient declared premises, unresolved meaning/necessity stays J and reserved decisions O. Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance/promotion; permitted discriminators stay within their subject, territory, operations and stops and claim no conformance. Correct mistaken routes at their smallest affected owner. C reuse binds request, candidate, basis, owner/root, projection, design trace/acceptance, rule, configuration and material evidence. Refresh affected results before reliance, preserving predecessor/successor identities, original cause/attempted subject, observed effects, surviving facts and affected J dependencies. Recompute wider frontier where independence is unproved; Ticket Method owns carrier and J/O continuity.
constraints.uncertainty: External Support/Currentness and continuity details are not supplied.

conditions: Closure of a declared change span.

grounding.quote:
A review event, passing aggregate, completed artifact or status change does not
discharge a missing required predicate in that conjunction.

constraints.statement: Closure evidence is subject to Contract application and the shared Result conjunction. Upstream must remain sufficient for downstream, downstream must not contradict active upstream truth, and tests/qualification must prove intended current behavior rather than precedent. No review event, passing aggregate, artifact completion or status supplies a missing predicate. Ticket Method owns recording/reuse and Workspace and context exact-claim applicability. During ticketed code/test mismatch, implementation is evidence, not authority: reconcile through admitted ticket, triage, lawful re-entry and governing requirement/design/module/graph/carrier/closure surface, retaining Ticket Method's local test-authority rule.
constraints.uncertainty: External conjunction, applicability and ticket rules are referenced rather than reproduced.

conditions: Within a Product-outcome-bearing work wave.
exceptions: An assurance capability explicitly defined as Product behavior may itself be delivered as Product progress.
The same artifact can be Product output and evidence for different claims when roles are separately declared.

grounding.quote:
Only material advance projects
Product progress.

constraints.statement: Progress claims and supported-path promotion use the same selected outcome instance and acceptance interval. For material advance of that unresolved outcome, established advance is satisfied; prerequisite-only, preservation-only and observed regression are falsified; unmeasured/undecidable movement is indeterminate with basis/scope diagnoses. Readiness/preservation have separate predicates that may be satisfied. Prerequisites name enabled Product obligations and remain bounded. Owner acceptance exhausts only that instance/interval, not enduring guarantees, recurring obligations or the wider family; witnesses remain preservation/regression evidence. Later work on it is preservation, a bounded prerequisite for another admitted outcome, or a new lawfully repriced change, never additional progress on the accepted instance. Choosing another already-defined unresolved outcome is Goals/work sequencing; changing meaning/scope or introducing an outcome re-enters Product. Completed matrices, ledgers, inventories, design artifacts, test suites or proof surfaces cannot select/enlarge/replace outcome meaning; evidence remains non-authoring even for an assurance Product. Outcome success is necessary delivery evidence, not complete Product/release closure.

conditions: Material realization growth in a Product-outcome-bearing wave.
exceptions: Independent parallel work may proceed under its own admitted basis.

grounding.quote:
Ended authority cannot be renewed by repair, continuation, evidence, active
ticket or run state, or prior admission

constraints.statement: Growth requires the selected unresolved outcome, an admitted named bounded prerequisite, or an admitted named bounded experiment whose stated observation discriminates a stated decision for it. Provisional grants neither enlarge/select outcomes, authorize downstream work, confer promotion/closure nor waive Prime/design/safety/authority/release law. Work-wave authority or explicitly bounded proxy admits/renews them in durable Goals/ticket authority with provisional bound and exhaustion/falsification conditions. Satisfying the experiment's discriminating observation exhausts it; drafting/validating contracts or tickets, active status and prior admission cannot create/extend/renew grants. Outcome acceptance, prerequisite discharge, experiment decision resolution, other admitted terminal conditions, rejection, withdrawal, supersession, repricing away or evidence falsification end the basis. Further material work then requires new owner/proxy admission. Retention for supported behavior, evidence, regression or donor material gives no growth authority. Consumers own deletion/archive/quarantine/salvage; salvage carries only expressly re-adopted semantics, not enclosing authority, dependencies, completion or work selection. Regression/unresolved gaps block affected-path promotion until repaired, repriced or owner-accepted, not all independent work; parallel activity cannot be counted as this outcome's progress.

exceptions: One coherent constraint family may be justified once without per-clause rationale fields, receipts or repeated audits.

grounding.quote:
Each constraint must identify the semantic ambiguity it
removes

constraints.statement: Each method constraint identifies ambiguity removed and contracts enough admissible interpretation space to justify complexity. Rival authority, failure-classification and evidence uncertainty count only insofar as materially different semantic/authority/outcome/acceptance interpretations remain; they are not additional benefits counted separately. Detailed algebra/Ontology/IACS/Prime/views can be proportional; short duplicate truth surfaces can be disproportionate. Symbolic design's divergent implementation paths/states/tests/reviews/joins are counterfactual evidence of alternatives, not an independent numerator; a bounded model resolving them within capacity is proportional, while prior design removing none is not. Additions duplicating truth or expanding reconciliation/reasoning without material ambiguity reduction are disproportionate. Existing obligations should absorb detail when ownership/meaning remain intact. Repeated acquisition/context/hashing/activation/status/review/evidence work serves an identified change, decision or assurance need; reuse requires applicability/invalidation and repetition proves neither validity nor independence. Material operational effects require UP-019 qualification, not a universal quota or new accounting carrier.
constraints.uncertainty: The proportionality relation supplies no numeric metric; UP-019 details are external.

grounding.quote:
This is a
priority relation, not a fixed global execution sequence or scheduling runtime.

constraints.statement: Priority considers the current outcome, likelihood, impact, reversibility, dependency and delayed-feedback cost. Probability cannot waive authority, integrity, safety, retained release claims or hard stops. Default priority exposes/advances the smallest supported Product path and highest-value likely failures. Defensive/prerequisite work displacing it identifies affected claim, evidence, bounded effort, return condition and expected Product consequence. Greater agent capacity can enlarge resolvable bounded relations but grants no authority and waives no invariant or acceptance.

conditions: Construction is delegated under the selected outcome and affected cone.
exceptions: Optional profiles add duties only where adopted.

grounding.quote:
A human, machine or mixed binding remains subject to the
same affected obligations

constraints.statement: Candidate bytes do not establish cone preservation. Continuation retains useful work and observes current state including unresolved effects; bounded steps preserve affected outer relations. Construction and passing assessment cannot appoint acceptance authority. Governing authorities select outcome, delegation and required independent assessment. Actual executor and observation boundary are bound without prescribing worker model, prompt, tools, search, topology, layout or orchestration; human/machine/mixed execution shares affected obligations.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited work/recovery specialization and later policy details outside supplied sections remain external.

conditions: For each proposed bounded action.

grounding.quote:
This section
consumes those laws; it does not create a second design package.

constraints.statement: Execution binding identifies selected Product outcome/prerequisite/admitted experiment, bounded affected relations and invariants, accepted transformation-admission relations, computational/common-library dispositions, construction/assessment authority and upstream re-entry conditions. Acquire the constraint surface and material subject for current A, admitted Z, bounded transition and result-establishing observations. Where Design Module Method applies, UP-017 bounded-frame conservation, UP-016 transformation-admission completeness, UP-018 invariant reconstruction and UP-019 computational-realization projection supply inputs; this creates no second design package.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced transformation and design input laws are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
does not block the bounded claim.

constraints.statement: Support determines material seams of the smallest coherent behavior-delivering cone and preservation of every affected governing relation. Unrelated incompleteness outside it is recorded for repricing and does not block its bounded claim.

conditions: Independent assessment supports promotion, for independent live assessment requirements.
exceptions: Direct-human acceptance remains required wherever Product or release law reserves it.

grounding.quote:
It
permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
at a boundary owned elsewhere.

constraints.statement: Constructor owns bounded implementation/self-review. Required independent assessment evaluates exact live realization, computational binding, authority paths, proof and installed subject; constructor summaries are insufficient. Shared independence binds actors without an actor-count prescription. Governing authority declares whether a proxy can accept/advance routine actions: it may accept preservation, require local repair, reject violations and advance already-authorized work, but cannot change Product meaning, requirements, authority or accepted design; such changes re-enter owners. Accepted basis/cone/decision envelope/re-entry conditions remove a need for human ceremony at every transition. A capable context with sufficient work authority, exact intake and operation grant may enter directly as constructor/Writer without Executive appointment; coordination depends on material contexts/authority/capability/independence, not names. Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission, smallest lawful carrier, assessment and reserved decisions, not self-acceptance. One grant may cover declared construction/status/checkpoint sequence; record actual role transitions in existing carrier, with no new grant or unchanged-subject rehash solely for status. Material operation/subject/territory/authority/validity changes require resolved bindings before effect. Executive mutation restrictions still apply.
constraints.uncertainty: External independence and Executive mutation restrictions are not fully supplied.

conditions: Assessment of the exact candidate's cone closure and preservation claim.

grounding.quote:
The proposed remedy retains its original domain outcome; the core verdict does
not choose among remedies.

constraints.statement: Assessment returns evidence and proposed semantic disposition; applied disposition is a separate decision under exact subject/basis/mandate. accept maps to satisfied when the cone closes preserving every affected relation. local_repair maps to falsified for demonstrated defect under coherent governing relation, or indeterminate for undecided candidate due to inadequate proof with supported local proof repair. re_enter maps to falsified when the intended candidate cannot meet an interpretable contract without owner change, or invalid_basis when governing requirements cannot support coherent interpretation. reject maps to falsified for a violated relation or undisposed competing truth path. Missing required reason/support gives indeterminate if no independently admissible evidence decides the predicate; retain raw label as non-deciding support, independent counterevidence and scope/basis diagnoses. Interpretable requirements are an admission condition; candidate/design alignment is evaluated, so contradictory design alone does not invalidate requirements and proof defects can falsify proof without falsifying implementation. Remedies require supported cause and authority; verdict alone selects none and forbids no useful authorized repair. Candidate availability is separate. Lawful recorded rejection can satisfy decision legality without establishing candidate counterexample and never overwrites assessment.
constraints.uncertainty: The full external Dispose and core conjunction operations are not instantiated here.

conditions: Repeated rejection occurs against one unchanged boundary, for reassessment.

grounding.quote:
Global correctness means conserving every global relation affected by the
bounded action.

constraints.statement: Global correctness preserves every affected global relation without requiring whole-Product proof in every local action. Repeated unchanged-boundary rejection requires reassessing frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design-versus-code placement and authority sufficiency. There is no rejection threshold, mandatory round count or review state machine; repeating an unchanged failed relation cannot close it by iteration alone.

exceptions: Whole-candidate qualification moves earlier when affected risk, uncertain impact or a mandatory gate requires it.

grounding.quote:
Transition
evidence is a read model and does not become specification, design, or
admission authority.

constraints.statement: A reviewable transition identifies exact candidate, affected relations, changed realization paths, added/removed authority paths, retained/open seams, focused and required integration proof, explicit non-changes, proposed disposition and separately applied decision. Consumers choose representation; evidence remains a read model. Focused proof binds affected source obligations, assertion/execution dependencies, supported exclusions, newly uncovered cases and mandatory gates under cited impact/risk laws. Proof must support the intended claim; cheap weaker falsification cannot close stronger claims. Retained evidence stays on its original subject with required new applicability; compare selection and reassessment costs together. Whole-candidate qualification stays at its declared boundary unless earlier assessment is required. When loss of incidental process state materially challenges durable/reconstructable authority, same-process proof alone is insufficient: destroy/exclude incidental authority and compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.
constraints.uncertainty: Cited evidence-selection and assertion laws are external.

grounding.quote: Reconstructability alone does not select reconstruction.

constraints.statement: Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint and allows the next already-authorized bounded action without renewed human approval, not wider outcome/cone. Preservation checkpoints may retain unfinished/unaccepted work under exact existing grant, naming predecessor, territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; they are not acceptance, promotion or publication. Continuation checks currentness over continuing workspace and retains applicable work/evidence; ordinary restart does not select rebuilding original A. Discard/rebuild recovery must justify why retained-work repair is insufficient, surviving obligations/evidence, changed causal assumptions and permitting existing grant. Accepted material Product movement follows UP-013; rejected/superseded construction is churn, a history/cost annotation proving neither movement nor noncompliance. Newly discovered hidden distance revises forecast, not implementation progress; paperwork/code/test/commit/review counts alone are not progress. These are semantic categories, not a numeric algorithm. Protocol violations include unreconstructable execution context, substituting constructor reports for required independent live evidence, proxy overreach, unrelated incompleteness blocking a closed cone, same-process proof for material cross-process authority and rejected work reported as accepted progress.

conditions: A consequential transition has actual admission owners.
exceptions: Participating owners may use a design-declared coherent composite basis instead of identical individual bases.

grounding.quote:
The owner
independently derives and validates that relation from authoritative inputs

constraints.statement: Each owner independently derives and validates the complete material transition from authoritative inputs, including every material participant/equality join and support across seams. Reuse applies Currentness and retains owner responsibility and separately required independent judgment. Material mutation, rollback, authority/basis change, expired validity and actual trust-boundary crossing require validation before reliance/effect; trust-boundary crossing applies even to unchanged facts. Completeness/validity/authority/prior-admission assertions and unsupported prior success do not establish facts. Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis through admission. If validity/currentness can advance after preflight, commit is conditional on declared predecessor/currentness law or derivation/validation restarts without effect. Individually valid judgments without equal or declared coherent composite bases cannot establish admission.

grounding.quote: `admitted`, `refused` or `effect-free re-entry` as the original outcome

constraints.statement: Preserve original admitted/refused/effect-free-re-entry outcomes. Complete relation and every applicable condition/material join established gives satisfied, supporting assessed admission but not proving commit. Forgery, stale predecessor, defeated grant, omitted required participant/join or other demonstrated violation of an interpretable relation gives falsified with specific reason. Enclosing ambiguity, missing support, undecided currentness or missing reason gives indeterminate, never guessed completeness/authority. Uninterpretable/contradictory subject/basis, including mixed owner bases without interpretable admitted composition, gives invalid_basis; outside evaluation scope/capability gives out_of_frame and leaves wider obligation open. Under interpretable composite bases, incompatible established joins are falsified, missing evidence indeterminate. Conjunction retains authenticated failures beside uncovered/invalid contributions; differing valid bases are not failure if coherent composition holds. Arbitrary supported predecessor states and direct/composite/nested forms share the contract. Not-applicable instead evaluates exclusion from design-supported boundary: supported exclusion satisfied, supported inclusion falsified, unresolved applicability indeterminate, with basis/scope diagnoses. It cannot replace admission assessment. Authorized admission/refusal/re-entry decisions have separate predicates and are not granted by assessment.

grounding.quote:
Admission satisfaction, actual semantic commit and atomicity are separate
claims.

constraints.statement: Required effect-free refusal must be observed: report not_started only if no requested effect began; retain actual partial/reverted/unknown effects at their boundaries. Observed subset publication falsifies complete-or-none even after satisfied preflight; unobserved publication stays unresolved and requires observation before dependent re-entry; labels cannot erase effects. Validate every participant/join before any transition effect. Internal order/reuse is implementation-owned, but no subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth. One complete semantic commit binds exact basis; failure/interruption admits all or none. No mechanism or participant count is prescribed. Every supported direct/composite/nested boundary preserves this law; partial results cannot replace owner derivation and competing same-scope routes cannot establish transitions. Fresh reconstruction/replay over the same basis reproduces relation, basis identity and complete outcome/refusal semantically. Asserted rather than derived completeness, omitted material seams, unidentified/stale/incoherent bases, unconditioned currentness advancement, early effects, exposed subsets, divergent reconstruction or competing same-scope authority falsify the law.

conditions: For every admission owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design, under supported input, state and operating/threat models.
exceptions: Excluded threats alone impose no acceptance predicate or defensive work.
Representative atomic-failure observations suffice only with design-declared dominance/equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface.

grounding.quote:
Final-participant validation
failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure evidence.

constraints.statement: Supported malformed inputs, stale states and effect boundaries retain checks; scope expansion returns to its owner. Each case reports the actual admission/applicability/publication predicate under the owning map, not a new conjunction or inferred effect absence. Required cases: direct complete derivation/validation/one admission; every supported composite/nested constituent and owner preserving the law, unsupported forms design-groundedly not_applicable without weaker routes; reachable forged identity/membership/equality/authority refused without effect, exclusion owned rather than limited by helper capability; enclosing participant/join/seam/identity ambiguity refused without effect; stale input refused and post-preflight advancement causing effect-free re-entry; incoherent bases retaining invalid_basis or interpretable-join failure/uncertainty while withholding admission and verifying no effect; competing same-scope paths unable to establish transition; fresh process and exact replay reproducing relation/basis/outcome/refusal; and post-validation failure/interruption at every materially distinct subset-exposing commit/publication boundary followed by fresh complete-or-none reconstruction. For an indivisible unit establish its boundary and observe failure immediately on both sides. Omitted owners/boundaries, uncovered partial-failure boundaries, weak helpers/manufactured refusals or incomplete semantic reconstruction comparisons falsify standing claims.

conditions: A change alters a load-bearing shared interface on which multiple surfaces depend.
exceptions: Explicitly disjoint compatibility scopes retain lawful latitude.
Bounded Product-slice proof follows the separate path-relative promotion rule.

grounding.quote:
the work must be handled as a constitutional migration rather than
as incremental patching.

constraints.statement: Change authoritative core contract first; prohibit bridge code as authoritative for that family; audit every impacted producer/consumer; migrate each to the new contract; follow all downstream effects until superseded closure law is absent; perform complete migration-closure proof only after the wave completes. Single-component change proves no preservation across unexamined producers/consumers/views. Mixed old/new producers, divergent runtime/reporting carriers, authoritative compatibility aliases, independent projection truth or green tests over split architecture cannot be declared complete. Human Product authority selects fundamental re-adoption; these preservation premises are not automatic deletion rules.

exceptions: The bounded-evolution selection presumption is rebuttable and does not require unsafe or inadmissible predecessors.
Explicit Product supersession need not preserve internal implementations or public mechanisms.

grounding.quote: Product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are distinct claims.

constraints.statement: Use inside-out hard-break for in-place replacement on one implementation line; use fundamental re-adoption for intentional major re-derivation on materially different runtime/carrier/type/substrate/realization basis, treating prior implementation as reference. When both are lawful/feasible and a working predecessor reaches the admitted outcome without competing/ambiguous authority, bounded evolution on supported path is presumed to conserve semantics/feedback; it is not a third strategy and uses hard-break for core changes. Re-adoption requires explicit affected-Product human selection comparing value, feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained semantics, plus bounded abort/re-entry; scale/preference alone do not select it. Neither strategy allows proxy partial implementation in acceptance, silently authoritative bridge/fallback, or competing authority on promoted paths. Full acceptance-path causal closure includes every admitted entrypoint, producer, consumer, resolver, fallback, shared state, event, projection and proof capable of changing/interpreting/closing the outcome; one successful trace is insufficient. Old/new authority both accepting the same request/fact/identity/state/projection blocks promotion. Residual superseded material off-path is deferrable only when explicitly non-authoritative for the outcome or within specified disjoint deterministically routed scope, unable to falsify current/retained claims, and retaining bounded migration/qualification/release disposition. Intermediate promotion additionally requires singular authority and preserves open migration/final retirement; slice criteria derive from Product and all causal live requirements, accepted design and retained claims, not narrowed ticket/review wording. Tests detect leaks/prove, not plan migration. Active migration cannot renew exhausted slice growth; admitted removal/demotion/closure proof may continue within bound without progress claims, but further producer/consumer growth needs another live UP-013 admission.

conditions: Every core interface migration.

grounding.quote: Every old path must then be classified as one of:

constraints.statement: Declare exact affected scope; every excluded/disjoint Product or compatibility scope with deterministic routing; new authoritative and superseded contracts/surfaces; new authoritative closure law; complete old/new producer and consumer sets; and every derivative projection/report/status/proof surface. Classify every old path as remove, replace, re-authorize or temporary scaffolding. Temporary scaffolding is lawful only when explicitly non-authoritative and scheduled for removal before closure.

conditions: A core interface migration.
exceptions: An explicit live-Product compatibility feature is lawful only if intentionally specified, explicitly bounded and clearly identified as compatibility rather than current native truth.

grounding.quote:
The only lawful exception is an explicit compatibility feature retained as part
of the live product.

constraints.statement: No compatibility alias remains authoritative; no fallback identity law remains silent runtime behavior; no bridge participates in acceptance as the new contract; no old reader/writer remains authoritative for an outcome once the new contract governs it; no proxy/partial interface stands between old/new truth as completion.

conditions: Runtime, reporting, status, topology and proof views of the migrated authoritative carrier.

grounding.quote:
This migration binding requires one governing closure relation across
those views.

constraints.statement: Views preserve the authoritative carrier under Faithful projection and share one governing closure relation. A different carrier/law permitting conflicts, a view independently closing an open source or retaining superseded closure law leaves migration incomplete even if the authoritative carrier can close.

conditions: Inside-out hard-break migration.
exceptions: Downstream exploration may occur as isolated non-authoritative work.

grounding.quote:
Inside-out hard-break migrations must proceed from the new authoritative source
carrier outward.

constraints.statement: Before proof serves as closure evidence, discover the full best-guess interface family including producers/consumers/projections/prompts/reports/wrappers/replay/ingest/bootstrap/proof. Authoritative producer/source-carrier work precedes downstream consumer/projection/prompt/dossier/report/review hardening. Exploration cannot land in public runtime/projection/prompt/report/proof entrypoints until source carrier is published and admitted. Dependent projection tickets cannot close while their source-carrier ticket remains open. Ticket dependencies explicitly expose source-to-read-model order.

conditions: Each break in an inside-out migration wave.
exceptions: Specified, deterministically routed, non-overlapping Product/compatibility scopes may coexist while migration is open.
Newly found interfaces leave the same wave only through explicit upward repricing.

grounding.quote:
re-enabling the old seam through wrappers, fallbacks, projections, or prompt
  paths is a migration defect

constraints.statement: A wave is ordered breaks over one family, not permission for competing/ambiguous dual truth over the same request/fact/identity/state/projection. For each break: publish/admit the deepest new authoritative carrier; deliberately sever one old authoritative seam; keep it broken; repair outward to consumers, projections, prompts/reports, then proof; negatively prove rejection rather than mere non-use. Tests may discover omissions but do not replace inventory. Newly discovered affected interfaces remain in the wave absent upward repricing; wrappers/fallbacks/projections/prompts must not restore severed authority.

conditions: Core interface changes.
exceptions: Bounded Product-slice proof may establish only the exact intermediate outcome allowed by path-relative promotion.

grounding.quote:
Complete migration-closure proof is not valid while producers and consumers
are split across old and new contracts.

constraints.statement: Complete closure proof follows migration, not split old/new architecture. Bridge-dependent passing tests and local green cannot establish closure. Slice proof cannot close migration. Each break must prove the severed old seam rejected or fail-closed before downstream hardening counts as progress.

conditions: Completion across the declared affected migration scope.
exceptions: Superseded mechanisms may remain for justified distinct supported responsibilities.
An enduring required cold-reconstruction route or independent oracle needs no invented expiry.
Retirement in a closed affected cone need not await unrelated whole-Product closure.

grounding.quote: Retention bears the burden.

constraints.statement: Completion requires every authoritative producer writing and consumer reading the new contract, superseded authority retired unless distinctly justified, projections downstream of the same truth, one runtime/reporting/topology/proof closure law, and no temporary scaffolding in acceptance. Otherwise migration stays active. Every retained superseded mechanism names current supported obligation, owner, purpose, execution scope and material cost. Temporary compatibility/comparison needs expiry/removal trigger; tests, oracle labels or nominal demotion do not justify duplicate production responsibility. Surviving obligations identify surviving owners; absent governing obligation requires no replacement guard. Accepted intermediate slices name what they close and visibly leave migration open, never projecting slice acceptance as migration/qualification/release closure.

grounding.quote:
Release criteria, publication and advancement remain Release Method's
decisions.

constraints.statement: Release identities and Selector/consumer adoption bind the exact operative cut separately from discovery. The immutable cut bounds the then-accepted feature set and belongs in release metadata/evaluation. Active constitutional/shared-realization surfaces describe current truth by role, boundary and status rather than release-line branding. Release Method retains criteria, publication and advancement decisions.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited Release Method sections are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
a witness establishes only its bound
property, and changed evidence does not author changed meaning or permission.

constraints.statement: A witness establishes only its bound property; changed evidence creates neither changed meaning nor permission. Construction assurance owns obligation-to-assertion-to-observation-to-supported-conclusion relations, Contract application binds selected operation, and Faithful projection binds derived views. Evaluators cannot substitute their target for the owner's property/scope.
constraints.uncertainty: The three referenced shared contracts are not supplied in full.

conditions: A load-bearing proof is selected or relied on.

grounding.quote:
Missing these
relations leaves evidence discovery, not closure-grade proof.

constraints.statement: Before witness selection, bind exact subject, intended property, governing basis, witness-to-claim relation, nearest weaker excluded property and falsification condition. State supported necessary/sufficient relation, required conjunction and discriminating observation. Interpretive fidelity and observed checker behavior remain separate obligations. Missing bindings yield discovery, not closure-grade proof. Packaging/syntax/compilation/file presence/invocation/local behavior cannot replace semantic, authority-bearing, installed, release or end-to-end proof merely through easier measurement.

grounding.quote: Evidence or view changes do not themselves change meaning.

constraints.statement: Verdicts apply Currentness and views Faithful projection. Evidence/view changes alone cannot change meaning. Semantic change requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance. Broad digest changes may conservatively invalidate review without proving every semantic relation changed.

conditions: Assurance is relied on for promotion or closure.

grounding.quote:
A claim's quantifier, population, and scope cannot exceed its evaluated
evidence.

constraints.statement: Assurance support covers the authoritative composite subject; single-carrier evidence leaves unexamined cross-carrier obligations open. Mechanical enforcement names an executable/reproducible predicate and a witness reachable through ordinary declared assurance; until both are observed, the claim stays open or explicitly downgraded to planned property. Planned/specification-only harnesses are not observed verification. Claims cannot exceed evaluated quantifier/population/scope. Generalization from local defects needs declared inference, comparable population, counterexample treatment and governing evidence. Later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict until the claim-evidence relation is superseded, withdrawn or requalified.

conditions: Qualification of generic method sufficiency.
exceptions: Material reference exposure is withheld before freeze wherever earlier exposure would compromise reconstructive independence.
Reference equivalence is required only where the governing basis requires it.

grounding.quote: Any post-exposure revision is a declared intervention

constraints.statement: Qualification consumes Probabilistic Work Boundary, UP-020 and Reconstruction Litmus, applying independent assessment and UP-007 review/promotion rules. Declare constructor competence/capability/context/configuration and evaluator authorization/basis/comparison predicate; use only declared ordinary inputs. Withhold material expected/reference outcomes, exemplars, incumbent realizations, author memory and ad hoc rescue until frozen wherever independence would be compromised. After freeze compare against mandatory governing semantics; applicable separately held references are optional non-authoritative evidence. Lawful alternatives can satisfy conformance on declared evidence. Subjective similarity is insufficient; byte/structural identity, unique derivation, determinism and incumbent equality are not generic criteria. Out-of-envelope construction cannot indict generic sufficiency. Post-exposure revision is an intervention classified as a method constituent with qualification boundary or new subject; it cannot retroactively pass the frozen result. No actor type/count, rounds, engine, prompt or orchestration is prescribed. Comparison must neither omit governing basis, use constructor instead of independent authority, nor self-adjust after results. Undeclared supplemental inputs, compromising early exposure, reference-as-authority, wrongly requiring/omitting reference equivalence, substitute identity criteria or unclassified/retroactive revisions violate the law.
constraints.uncertainty: Probabilistic Work Boundary and UP-007 are not supplied.

conditions: Derived guidance changes or native-use, mechanical or operational claims are made.

grounding.quote:
Digest integrity and index generation establish identity
and structure, not semantic fidelity or usability.

constraints.statement: Qualify changed guidance against source-derived expected behavior including affected permissions, exclusions and invalidators. Native-use claims require an ordinary actor using declared entry and available context. Digest integrity/index generation establish identity/structure, not fidelity/usability. Mechanical/operational claims require executable observations, including applicable UP-019 workloads/assumptions; semantic agreement cannot substitute.

exceptions: Constraints, governance and verification-infrastructure requirements may need other evidence in addition to or instead of end-to-end scenarios.

grounding.quote:
The scenario must expose operational behavior rather than merely
compare the specification's words with other words.

constraints.statement: Requirement/design words alone do not demonstrate capability; without an adequate scenario the Product-owner layer has not shown it. Scenarios test actual operational behavior through the chain, not verbal similarity. Failure supplies intake discrepancy but alone does not distinguish realization defect, inadequate governing meaning, prediction error or inadequate scenario/oracle/observation. Scenarios principally validate capabilities and concrete behavior, not replace requirement categories.

conditions: Every executable proof surface or claimed proof lane.

grounding.quote: Every executable proof surface must declare its authority source.

constraints.statement: SPEC_METHOD owns urn:stdo:bounded-context:product-assurance and Product taxonomy; Design Module Method retains module-unit-proof law despite shared context. Declare each proof's authority. Ticketed proof immediately derives from admitted ticket/triage and lawful re-entry sources, never current implementation as expected truth. Bind expectations to owning source/justified interpretation and execution to actual subject/checker/environment/observations. Labels prove neither assertion fidelity nor independent causes. Implementation-derived regression stays local, not upstream acceptance; shared derivations may serve declared families in existing carriers. Design/module tests derive from design, module ownership, IACS/equivalent inventory, diagrams where present and local fail-closed law, asking correct realization of boundary. Unit tests belong here; module integration/negative/fail-closed tests may also when their target is a designed boundary. UAT derives from requirements, acceptance criteria, scenarios/use cases and Product release/qualification claims, asking composed Product satisfaction. Size/speed/determinism/live breadth do not determine authority class.
constraints.uncertainty: External module-unit-proof and provenance laws are not fully supplied.

exceptions: An explicitly equivalent isolated composed-Product proof lane may use the UAT/acceptance name.

grounding.quote:
only sandbox tests or an explicitly equivalent isolated
composed-product proof lane may be called UAT / acceptance tests.

constraints.statement: UAT requires deployed/installed/otherwise runnable Product through declared application/public/runtime/control surfaces, driven by requirement-sourced scenarios or acceptance cases. Source unit/helper/module integration checks alone cannot close user acceptance. Harnessed sandbox runs the full composed path with deterministic/fake/recorded/injected worker results and proves composition/orchestration/control/projection/archive/scenario wiring reproducibly. Live sandbox uses real configured workers/tools/agents/services/external probabilistic transport where depended on, proving scenario passage through real boundary and result/evaluation/provenance/projection surfaces. For live-dependent Product/release claims, semantic/unit/module-integration/harnessed green are necessary but insufficient. Unit denotes design scope, integration breadth, sandbox composed acceptance, harnessed/fake/recorded/deterministic non-live execution, and live actual external worker/transport—not a status view called live. Alternative filenames/runner labels must map every executable lane to the taxonomy before closure.

conditions: Required closure lanes and proof using external project evidence.
exceptions: External evidence may be supplied through a checked-in minimal fixture or declared source/version/acquisition-or-binding manifest.
Alternatively classify the test as harnessed sandbox, live sandbox, reference comparison or optional local evidence rather than required semantic closure.

grounding.quote:
an unavailable fixture is not by itself a
Product counterexample.

constraints.statement: Required lanes reproduce from declared source boundary. Unit/semantic/module-design lanes cannot depend on undeclared local paths, sibling workspaces, home directories or mutable external fixtures. Missing external fixtures fail with governed diagnostic naming fixture authority and lane, not a Product semantic failure. Insufficient Product evidence gives indeterminate while retaining independent counterevidence/basis/scope diagnoses; a separate fixture-availability predicate may be falsified on established absence. Preserve whether Product evaluation occurred.

conditions: Every live requirement.

grounding.quote: Every live requirement must have written testcase authority.

constraints.statement: Written, traceable testcase authority is required. It may use scenario bundles, ordered sequences, negative/control or other explicit evidence cases appropriate to truth type. Informal confidence, ambient habit or unlabeled test corpora alone cannot fully prove a live requirement.

conditions: A requirement claims meaningful system behavior.

grounding.quote:
the proving surface should
be a scenario bundle or equivalent ordered set of testcases

constraints.statement: Isolated assertions alone do not prove features. The proving surface should use a scenario bundle or equivalent ordered cases coherently exercising behavior, identifying feature/use-case boundary, proving sequence and expected outcomes at significant steps. Declared scenarios pressure intent/design to name real operational boundaries, sequence, actors, controls and outcomes, and are the preferred source for significant code/control paths the proof must exercise. The bundle form is a recommendation, not an exclusive mandatory carrier.

conditions: The system has an installable or runnable development form.

grounding.quote:
the decisive
proving lane runs against an installed development version

constraints.statement: The decisive lane tests installed development as an independent project/externalized target, not source-in-place alone. It should prefer a fresh sandbox/equivalent isolation, installed/built artifact and real Product entry/control/runtime surfaces. Useful source/unit checks do not replace installed-dev proof.

conditions: Behavior is claimed.

grounding.quote:
If the significant paths are not declared, scenario coverage cannot be judged.
If they are declared but not exercised, the behavior is not fully proved.

constraints.statement: Declare and exercise significant paths intentionally; exhaustiveness is meaningful-path proof rather than every branch in every file. Typical paths, where relevant, are intended success, fail-closed/rejection, boundary/control, integration/dispatch/transport and recovery/retry/replay. Undeclared paths prevent judging coverage; declared unexercised paths leave behavior unproved.

conditions: Every live requirement family.
exceptions: A path, filename or packaging rule belongs in requirements when itself constitutional truth.

grounding.quote: Requirements remain part of the constitutional layer in all four cases.

constraints.statement: Categorize families by asserted truth: Capability, Constraint/Guarantee, Governance or Verification. All remain constitutional WHAT; Design is structural HOW with ADRs as one durable form; Scenarios validate capability operation. Category implies neither priority nor user-facing status. Not every requirement should become a marketed feature. Requirements should avoid prematurely freezing concrete realization; nonconstitutional paths, filenames and packaging belong to Design.

exceptions: Current accepted relations may reuse exact basis and sufficient evidence after applicability/invalidation checks.
A local selected claim need not reconstruct the whole Product.

grounding.quote:
Reconstructability requires a correct reconstruction route, not its execution
at every use.

constraints.statement: Being specification-driven requires ordered reconstructability; a competent team should derive each stated conformant layer. Multiple designs and software/human/mixed realizations are allowed. Failure to derive Intent diagnoses unclear/contradictory/insufficiently concrete Goals; Product failure vague/contradictory/nonconcrete Intent; Requirements failure underspecified/contradictory/nondecomposable Product; Design failure underspecified/contradictory/implementation-polluted Requirements; Realization failure incomplete/ambiguous/nonoperational Design for its binding. ADR/design decisions govern realization. Hidden major ambiguity makes an upstream surface insufficient despite producing an artifact. Correct routes need not run at every use, grant no restart authority and excuse no stale success; new material counterexamples challenge affected relations. Claim selects span. Applicable Design Module Method owns view coverage, material-change gate and unchanged-view reuse; this litmus neither waives that gate nor demands recreating unchanged accepted views.
constraints.uncertainty: External design-view law is not supplied; no reconstruction is performed here.

exceptions: Upstream constitutional constraints can already fix technology, carrier, runtime, path or placement.

grounding.quote: Design decides the concrete mechanism that realizes them.

constraints.statement: Requirements state required control/delivery surfaces; Design chooses their concrete mechanisms. Unconstrained stack/carrier/runtime choice is Design, not a new upstream authority. Requirements may demand authoritative bootstrap/control surfaces carrying bare axioms and canonical-method routes; Design chooses entry documents, embedded blocks, compiled artifacts or other lawful topology. Hardcoded filenames/placement without constitutional necessity absorb design detail and hinder re-derivation.
